exposure: Time of day of second stage onset
outcome: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 21,034 nulliparous women with singleton, cephalic, nonanomalous term births who achieved 10-cm cervical dilation
finding: Delayed pushing was associated with longer second stage duration, increased odds of cesarean delivery and postpartum hemorrhage, but not with neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Delayed pushing was associated with greater rates of cesarean delivery and operative vaginal delivery
